svg.title: Earlier public sources face the later wiki report
svg.desc: Separate earlier public accounts from the later report around a blank wiki lane. Absence from an account becomes a disclosure question, not automatic proof of concealment.

Absence from an account becomes a disclosure question, not automatic proof of concealment.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.58, 0.04, 0.38, 0.31980000000000003 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "paper", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.504744, 0.3913, 0.212301 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "AUGUST ACCOUNTS", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.729912, 0.3913, 0.093284 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "paper", "box": [ 0.52275, 0.504744, 0.3913, 0.212301 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "4 SEPTEMBER REPORT", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.729912, 0.3913, 0.093284 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "boundary", "box": [ 0.49363, 0.406608, 0.01274, 0.479776 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "split", "source": "
**Frame:** Curt lays the two 26 August reports and the Black Hat talk, the book's whole public account, on one side of the desk. On the other side, the 4 September report. Between them, a blank lane on the page plan with the label he gave it on [page 109](109.md).

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> It was public the whole time and I did not find it. The September report made the missing lane visible to me.
>
> Public is not the same as disclosed. I am not the one who was owed an account, and the question stands anyway.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `inferred` — creator exchange; the distinction between public traces and a public incident account is the project's, drawn from `CW-REPORT`'s disclosure discussion.

", "title": "Earlier public sources face the later wiki report" } }
